text:
deploy-bot: Deploybot paused release v1.42.3 -> prod. Preflight check FAILED: keystore secret suffix normalization mismatch detected between staging and prod (staging: `model-keystore-v2`, prod: `model-keystore-legacy_v2`). Blocking rollout. See preflight: https://ci.internal/release/5421/preflight

Sam: @Maya / @Dana ping — can someone weigh in? is this safe to unpause?

Dana: I pulled the preflight. Staging already applied helm chart 1.3.0 with `normalizeSecretSuffix: true`. Prod still has older behavior. If we let this go, model-proxy won't pick up TLS certs (it expects `model-keystore-v2`), could cause 503s on model endpoints.

Kevin: how did staging get the new name? we didn't change the app code.

Anuj: Chart 1.3.0 introduced suffix normalization to standardize secret names. We enabled it in canary values last week. Looks like prod values weren't updated — so staging has normalized names, prod still uses legacy suffixes.

Sam: Options: 1) backfill prod with new secret names (needs KMS ops + cert rotation), 2) pin chart behavior (set `normalizeSecretSuffix=false`) for this release and roll forward, 3) rollback release. Rough pros/cons?

Dana: Backfilling will require key material copy and a KMS audit — higher blast risk during the change window. Pinning is fastest: override to preserve legacy names, redeploy canary and resume rollout. Rollback is safest but will delay release window.

Kevin: can we patch the helm values without a full rollback? Deploybot supports overrides right?

deploy-bot: I can apply `--set normalizeSecretSuffix=false` as a helm override and trigger a canary re-deploy. Action requires explicit approval by release manager and prod oncall.

Maya: I'm release manager for this window. Sam/Dana — are you ok with the pin + follow-up migration plan? Also note: we already pushed the 18:00 window back 30m to investigate.

Zoe (oncall): If we pin and proceed, we MUST add a runbook entry for suffix normalization migration and monitoring for cert reload errors. I'll watch metrics.

Sam: I'll open a minimal PR to set the override and add a rollback command snippet: `deploybot rollback --to-tag v1.42.2`. Will also update release notes.

deploy-bot: Action: created helm override patch in canary namespace (job id 5421). Release remains paused until human unpause. @Maya please confirm.

Maya: +1 to pin. Sam, apply and verify canary health then ping me to unpause.

Sam: Applying now... logs: `kubectl rollout status deploy/model-proxy -n canary` -> pods ready. No cert errors in canary logs. :white_check_mark:

Dana: Confirming canary looks clean. Add to release notes: "temporary pin to avoid keystore secret normalization; migration planned in follow-up maintenance window."

Kevin: We should schedule the migration checklist: 1) backup existing keystore, 2) create new secret names in prod with KMS-wrapped keys, 3) rotate certs during maintenance window, 4) validate cert reload and rollback plan. Assign owners.

Sam: Created GH issue #3887 with the checklist and assigned to @Anuj and @Kevin for next-week maintenance window.

Maya: Unpausing for staged rollout to prod with pinned behavior. Monitoring window: 15m.

Zoe (oncall): Monitoring OK so far. No increase in 5xxs. Will escalate if error rate > 1%.

Sam: Rollout progressed. Deploy resumed and promoting to prod. I updated release notes and the changelog entry.

Dana: Thanks all. I'll draft a short postmortem and attach the planned normalization migration.

deploy-bot: Release resumed by Maya at 2339998999. Note: automatic rollback will trigger if errors >5% for 5m.

Sam: Closing this thread after postmortem link added.

Dana: I'll post the postmortem and migration plan in #eng-releases-docs once ready. Thanks everyone.
